name: Caterpillar - Aurora (Montgomery) IL Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (wheel loaders; site reportedly listed for sale)

fieldNotes.site: Confirmed via web search as the former Caterpillar Aurora/Montgomery wheel-loader plant at 325 S Route 31, ~350-acre / 4M+ sq ft campus now marketed as 'The Grid at Route 31'. Geocoded point sits inside the main manufacturing complex.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Divided entry boulevard off Route 31 (NW corner) with a gatehouse in the median - confirmed in z20 satellite and 2018 Street View showing the booth straight ahead and a CATERPILLAR sign on the main building.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Substantial pyramid-roof gatehouse straddling the median between the inbound and outbound lanes - classic staffed booth footprint.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide divided entry boulevard with generous paved width and a long approach drive - ample room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long divided entry drive from Route 31 to the buildings, easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Entry boulevard is divided into separate in and out lanes either side of the gatehouse median; counted as together-at-one-point but with split lanes - left entryExitTogether/Separate both false-leaning, primary gate is one location with divided lanes.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on the north building (south face, trailers backed in) is physically separate from material yards on the south side of the campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Heavy-manufacturing plant - no large conventional DC dock-door bank; ~20 visible truck doors estimated across the north building and main complex; low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large outdoor trailer/equipment storage yards on the south side and a trailer cluster (~8-10) near the north building.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs along the east edge with a spur entering the property on the south side - visible in z16/z18 imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple distinct large buildings (main manufacturing complex, north building, south buildings) on one ~298-acre campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town setting in unincorporated Montgomery surrounded by farmland and a rail corridor - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left false, flagged uncertain.
